# Class: `FrameSource`

The common interface consumed by frame display, navigation, and grayscale analysis.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-frame-source.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_frame_source.py#L124) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `object`.

Ranges passed to `iter_gray_arrays` are inclusive. `frame_key` identifies a frame for caches and per-frame edits; a displayed basename is not a unique substitute. Base methods can raise `NotImplementedError`; there is no formal abstract-base-class enforcement.
